tools.name: list_services
tools.description: The service categories vendors on Mediawork offer, such as Editorial, Sound Post or Visual Effects. Each has a uuid — pass it as `service` to search_facilities to filter the directory to vendors offering that service. Call this first when a question is about a kind of work.

locale.description: Two-letter language code (en, fr, es, pt, it, de, nl, pl, th, hi, ko, ja). Defaults to English.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Cities, states and countries that have at least one vendor listed, with a count of how many. Use a place `slug` as the `place` argument to search_facilities.

locale.description: Two-letter language code (en, fr, es, pt, it, de, nl, pl, th, hi, ko, ja). Defaults to English.

tools.name: search_facilities
tools.description: Search publicly listed post-production facilities, distribution vendors and creative companies. Filter by free text, by place slug (from list_places) and by service uuid (from list_services). To find vendors somewhere, prefer `place`; a `query` naming a place is treated as one anyway, and the response reports it as `resolvedPlace`. Results are paginated; when `hasMore` is true, call again with the returned `nextOffset`.

query.description: Free text matched against facility and company names, or a place name

locale.description: Two-letter language code (en, fr, es, pt, it, de, nl, pl, th, hi, ko, ja). Defaults to English.

tools.name: get_facility
tools.description: The full public profile for one vendor: services offered, creatives on the team and what each of them does, production types, rooms and spaces, equipment by make and model, and addresses. Takes the `companySlug` and `facilitySlug` pair returned by search_facilities.

locale.description: Two-letter language code (en, fr, es, pt, it, de, nl, pl, th, hi, ko, ja). Defaults to English.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Mediawork's published FAQ, grouped by category. With a query, returns matching questions and their answers; without one, returns every question so you can pick which to search for.

query.description: Matched against both questions and answers

locale.description: Two-letter language code (en, fr, es, pt, it, de, nl, pl, th, hi, ko, ja). Defaults to English.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: Published posts from the Mediawork blog, newest first. Use get_blog_post with a returned `slug` to read one in full.

locale.description: Two-letter language code (en, fr, es, pt, it, de, nl, pl, th, hi, ko, ja). Defaults to English.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: The full body of one published blog post, as markdown.

locale.description: Two-letter language code (en, fr, es, pt, it, de, nl, pl, th, hi, ko, ja). Defaults to English.

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Mediawork's subscription plans: what each includes, and its prices, plus `comparison`, a feature-by-feature table of every plan. Prices are published in several currencies — pass `currency` to return just one.

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. USD, GBP, EUR

locale.description: Two-letter language code (en, fr, es, pt, it, de, nl, pl, th, hi, ko, ja). Defaults to English.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search everything Mediawork publishes — vendor directory listings, FAQ entries and blog posts — and return matching records as {id, title, url}. Pass an `id` to `fetch` to read one in full. If your client supports them, the dedicated tools (search_facilities, search_faq, …) give richer, filterable results.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve the full contents of one record by the `id` returned from `search`.

id.description: An id from a search result
